name: video
description: Code-rendered films: seek(t) HTML, Playwright frames, ffmpeg encode

scripts.film: node scripts/render.mjs films/2026-09-it-report/film.src.html --out out/video.mp4 --sub 8 && uv run --with numpy scripts/score.py out/2026-09-it-report.events.json out/score.wav && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/video.mp4 -i out/score.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 192k -shortest -movflags +faststart out/it-report-2026-09.mp4
scripts.intro: python3 scripts/voice.py films/2026-10-parkops-intro/narration.json && python3 films/2026-10-parkops-intro/plan.py && node scripts/render.mjs films/2026-10-parkops-intro/film.src.html --out out/parkops-intro.video.mp4 --sub 8 && uv run --with numpy films/2026-10-parkops-intro/music.py out/parkops-intro.wav && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/parkops-intro.video.mp4 -i out/parkops-intro.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 192k -shortest -movflags +faststart out/parkops-intro.mp4
